definitions.explanation: A dish or type of cooking that features meat as the main ingredient.

examples.japanese: {肉料理|にくりょうり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{肉料理|にくりょうり}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: This restaurant is famous for its meat dishes.

examples.japanese: ⟦フランス→フランス：19418_furansu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{肉料理|にくりょうり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{赤|あか}ワイン→赤ワイン：18930_akawain⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Red wine is said to go well with French meat dishes.

notes:
{肉料理|にくりょうり} is a general term for any dish featuring meat as its main ingredient. It covers a wide range of preparations — grilled, stewed, fried, or roasted — regardless of the type of meat used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肉料理|にくりょうり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make a meat dish
- {肉料理|にくりょうり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧: to go well with meat dishes
- {肉料理|にくりょうり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧: to be good at cooking meat dishes
- {肉料理|にくりょうり}⟦{専門店|せんもんてん}→専門店：15924_senmonten⟧: restaurant specializing in meat dishes
